name: Speak with Gramma
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Please, adventurer, talk with my Gramma.  If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.

She's inside our house east of here.
narrative.offerRewardText:
While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.

Hm, what can we do...

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 6 to 7, 1,540 XP in all.

quests.name: Young Lovers
quests.objectiveText: Give Maybell's Love Letter to Tommy Joe Stonefield.

quests.name: Note to William
quests.objectiveText: Take Gramma Stonefield's Note to William Pestle.

quests.name: Collecting Kelp
quests.objectiveText: Bring 4 Crystal Kelp Fronds to William Pestle in Goldshire.

quests.name: The Escape
quests.objectiveText: Take the Invisibility Liquor to Maybell Maclure.
